tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The ground behind the app frame: the outermost page colour, the rail's own colour, so rail and ground read as one dark frame around the sheet. Never put text straight on it; text sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The app frame and every plain card: the main reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inside a card: inputs, segmented controls, a hovered table row, the selected range tab's track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between table rows and around quiet cards. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (outline buttons, inputs, the select pill) and unfilled star outlines: at least 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures, on surface, surface-sunken and every pastel (lavender, mint, butter, sky-soft, rose).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — labels, column headers, meta lines ("Kreuzberg · 2.1 km to work") — on surface and surface-sunken. On a pastel card use ink-soft instead.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the pastel cards (lavender, mint, butter, sky-soft, rose), where ink-muted runs too light.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The sidebar and the dark status card. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: rail-raised
tokens.usage: The active sidebar item's tile, and inner shapes on the dark status card.

tokens.name: rail-ink
tokens.usage: Inactive sidebar icons and secondary text on rail and rail-raised.

tokens.name: rail-ink-strong
tokens.usage: The active sidebar icon, and headings on the dark status card (on rail and rail-raised).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The logo tile — the butter square the house mark sits on. The same in both themes; the mark on it is always brand-ink.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The house mark and any glyph on a brand fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Links, the rent chart's line and point, the selected segment's text, and the focus ring's colour. As text, on surface, surface-sunken and sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: The rent chart card's ground and the area under its line; ink and sky text read on it.

tokens.name: sky-bright
tokens.usage: The one action on the dark status card ("Pause" or "Resume"), with on-sky-bright text. Only ever sits on rail.

tokens.name: on-sky-bright
tokens.usage: Text on a sky-bright fill.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Stat card ground: Matches. Ink and ink-soft read on it.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Stat card ground: Near matches; also the Match tag's fill. Ink, ink-soft and match read on it.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Stat card ground: Shortlisted; also the Near match tag's fill. Ink, ink-soft and near read on it.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: The Warned tag's fill and a reason chip that doesn't fit. Ink, ink-soft and warned read on it.

tokens.name: match
tokens.usage: Match: the band tag's text. On surface and mint.

tokens.name: near
tokens.usage: Near match: the band tag's text. On surface and butter.

tokens.name: warned
tokens.usage: Warned: the band tag's text, and an alarm Notice's title. On surface and rose.

tokens.name: warned-solid
tokens.usage: Alarms only — the dot of a Cooldown or "needs you" status, the new-offer dot. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: hidden
tokens.usage: Hidden: the band tag's text. On surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: The status dot when hunting is running. A mark, not text: 3:1 on rail and surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring on every control: 2px solid, 2px off the edge. An alias of sky, 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: rail-focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring inside the sidebar and on the dark status card.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links ("See all").

tokens.name: notice-info-line
tokens.usage: The border of an info Notice. Decorative: the Notice's words carry its meaning.

tokens.name: notice-warn-line
tokens.usage: The border of a warn Notice.

tokens.name: notice-alarm-line
tokens.usage: The border of an alarm Notice.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dim behind the sign-in layer, a confirmation, a menu on a phone and the Offer panel on a narrow screen.

families.sans: "Manrope Variable", Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page title in the top bar. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles above a card or a row of cards.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The one headline number of a card: median rent, a stat card's count. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A stat card's count when four sit in a row, the warm rent in an Offer's detail.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A row's warm rent and other values the eye should land on.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, field labels, tag text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under a title: district, move-in, when it was seen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a glyph and its word; inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its meta line; gaps in a chip row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items in the top bar; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutters between cards; padding of small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of stat cards and the chart card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards; space between a section title and its cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The app frame's inner padding; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of the page to the title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, menu items, the skip link, and the focus ring of check rows, Disclosure heads, the offers table's title links and the chart's scrub area.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Offer thumbnails, menus, Notices, the rail's items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Every card: stat cards, the chart card, the offers table card, the status card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The app frame — the white sheet that sits on canvas — and the side panel beside it.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the select pill, status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on surface. Barely there; cards are set apart by their fill.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: What floats: the status card, menus, tooltips, the Confirm, the Offer panel's close button, the skip link. Not the sheet or the side panel: on the dark canvas they are flat.
